encode_c2c_message: encode a C2C direct message as WebSocket-ready ConnMsg protobuf bytes for sending
encode_group_message: encode a group chat message as WebSocket-ready ConnMsg protobuf bytes for sending
decode_inbound_push: decode an inbound message push payload from raw protobuf bytes into a dict
encode_auth_bind: encode an auth-bind request as ConnMsg bytes for WebSocket authentication
decode_conn_msg: decode raw ConnMsg protobuf bytes into a dict with msg_type, seq_no, and data
